name: agent-iris-wipe
prompt: Transition: an iris wipe — a circle growing from the center reveals the incoming layer, with a soft edge slider.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

definition.label: Iris Wipe

summary: I wrote `gen.iris-wipe`: a circle grows from the center to reveal `u_to`, with a keyframeable `softness` slider for the edge (default 0.05, range 0–0.5). The radius grows to the corner distance plus the softness, so the incoming layer fully covers the frame at `u_prog` = 1. It hasn't been compiled or rendered, and the `v_st`/`u_res` names are borrowed from the effect docs because the transition docs don't list varyings.
